svg.title: HR Onboarding Portal - AWS architecture, data security and workflow
svg.text: HR Onboarding Portal - AWS architecture, data security and workflow
Target deployment of the Employee portal (react_onboard.py) and HR portal (hr_info.py). The AI model stays on the Google Gemini API; storage moves from local JSON/files to DynamoDB and S3.

workflow step

svg.text: Region: ap-south-1 (Mumbai) - data stays in India
HR host rule: Cognito OIDC + MFA
Task IAM role: least privilege per S3 prefix / table / secret
Container images from ECR; logs to CloudWatch; app binds 0.0.0.0 behind the ALB
ALB security group: 443 from the CloudFront managed prefix list only
Task security group: 8000 / 8001 only from the ALB security group; no inbound from the internet
Network ACLs per subnet tier; VPC Flow Logs go to CloudWatch
HR portal on its own host (hr.example.com): MFA login plus an optional corporate IP allow-list
Tasks reach the internet only through the NAT Gateway (Gemini API); no other egress
Aadhaar, PAN, photo, resume, certificates, bank proofs
SSE-KMS, versioning, Block Public Access, TLS-only policy
Documents served by short-lived pre-signed URLs
Tables: submissions, forms, flags (replaces JSON files)
Private link token stored as a hash; status New to Approved
KMS encryption, point-in-time recovery, deletion protection
Separate keys for S3, DynamoDB and secrets
Yearly rotation; key policy limits use to the task roles
Rotation reminders; readable only by the portal task role
Emails the employee's private application link
DKIM / SPF / DMARC, TLS delivery, no document attached
Portal container images, scan on push, immutable tags
Encrypted with KMS; pulled over the ECR VPC endpoints
HTTPS 443 egress only, key sent in x-goog-api-key header
Security monitoring & governance - logs and findings from CloudFront, WAF, ALB, VPC, ECS, S3 and DynamoDB land here
S3 and alerts on public or

g.text: Employee opens the portal: Route 53, then CloudFront with WAF (HTTPS only, rate limits, bot and OWASP rules); Shield absorbs DDoS.
The ALB (ACM certificate, TLS 1.2+) forwards to the Employee Portal task on :8000 in a private subnet.
Uploads (max 5 MB, real JPG/PDF checked by magic bytes) are written to S3 through the gateway endpoint, encrypted with KMS.
Extract: the task reads the Gemini key from Secrets Manager, shrinks images to 1024 px and calls the AI model through the NAT Gateway.
Submit: the server re-validates, creates the ID (IGTPLnnn) and private token, saves the record and form to DynamoDB, status New.
HR opens hr.example.com: Cognito sign-in with MFA happens at the ALB before any request reaches the HR Portal.
HR Portal (:8001) reads DynamoDB, opens documents by short-lived S3 pre-signed URL, flags items; Approve is blocked while flags are open.
Send back: status Changes Requested, SES emails the private link; the employee fixes and resubmits (token checked), status New again.
In transit
HTTPS everywhere: TLS 1.2+ on CloudFront and the ALB; AWS-internal calls use VPC endpoints; the Gemini call is HTTPS-only.
At rest
S3, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, ECR and logs use customer-managed KMS keys; S3 versioning, Block Public Access, DynamoDB PITR.
Access control
Cognito + MFA for HR; employees use a 128-bit private token (hash stored); IAM roles scoped per table and S3 prefix; no keys in code.
PII protection
Aadhaar / PAN images only in private S3 (no public URLs); Macie scans for PII; lifecycle retention; IDs scrubbed from application logs.
Detection & audit
CloudTrail (with S3 data events), GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config rules and CloudWatch alarms; logs kept in a locked log bucket.
Resilience
Multi-AZ Fargate, S3 / DynamoDB durability, AWS Backup, WAF rate limiting. Replaces local JSON files and the plain-text .env.
